#!/bin/bash
set -e

# 1. Hash the password ON THE HOST
HASH=$(python3 - <<'EOF'
import base64, hashlib, os
salt = os.urandom(16)
key = hashlib.pbkdf2_hmac('sha512', os.environ['MASS_PASSWORD'].encode(), salt, 100000, 64)
print('@ByteArray(' + base64.b64encode(salt).decode() + ':' + base64.b64encode(key).decode() + ')')
EOF
)

# 2. Stop qBittorrent, set username and hash under [Preferences], start it
pct exec 105 -- systemctl stop qbittorrent-nox.service
pct exec 105 -- sed -i '/^\[Preferences\]/a WebUI\\Username=admin\nWebUI\\Password_PBKDF2='"$HASH" /var/lib/qbittorrent-nox/.config/qBittorrent/qBittorrent.conf
pct exec 105 -- systemctl start qbittorrent-nox.service

# Wait for qBittorrent to be ready
sleep 5

# 3. PROVE the login from the host
LOGIN_RESULT=$(curl -s -d "username=admin&password=$MASS_PASSWORD" http://192.168.1.24:8080/api/v2/auth/login)
if [ "$LOGIN_RESULT" != "Ok." ]; then
    echo "LOGIN FAILED: $LOGIN_RESULT"
    exit 1
fi
echo "LOGIN SUCCESS: $LOGIN_RESULT"

# 4. Tell Radarr and Sonarr the same credentials through their APIs

# Get Radarr API key
RADARR_KEY=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/radarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\\(.*\\)</ApiKey>.*:\\1:p" | head -n 1')

# Get Sonarr API key
SONARR_KEY=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'cat /var/lib/sonarr/config.xml 2>/dev/null | sed -n "s:.*<ApiKey>\\(.*\\)</ApiKey>.*:\\1:p" | head -n 1')

# Update Radarr download client with credentials
pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"movieCategory\":\"radarr\",\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"'"$MASS_PASSWORD"'\"}" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/1'

# Update Sonarr download client with credentials
pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s -X PUT -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"name\":\"qBittorrent\",\"implementation\":\"QBittorrent\",\"enable\":true,\"host\":\"192.168.1.24\",\"port\":8080,\"tvCategory\":\"tv-sonarr\",\"username\":\"admin\",\"password\":\"'"$MASS_PASSWORD"'\"}" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/1'

# Test Radarr download client
RADARR_TEST=$(pct exec 103 -- sh -c 'curl -s -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: '"$RADARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{}" http://127.0.0.1:7878/api/v3/downloadclient/test')
echo "Radarr test result: $RADARR_TEST"

# Test Sonarr download client
SONARR_TEST=$(pct exec 104 -- sh -c 'curl -s -X POST -H "X-Api-Key: '"$SONARR_KEY"'" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{}" http://127.0.0.1:8989/api/v3/downloadclient/test')
echo "Sonarr test result: $SONARR_TEST"
